D012_l001.question: A 28-year-old single female, a PhD Researcher, presents with a 7-month history of significant distress related to natural environmental phenomena.     B. Acute Stress Disorder
    C. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
    D. Schizophrenia
